vercel.note: Official Vercel MCP server (https://mcp.vercel.com). OAuth-only: the first time it connects, Cursor shows a 'Needs login' prompt that must be authorized interactively from the Cursor desktop IDE. Headless/cloud agents cannot complete this OAuth flow, and cloud-agent network access must allowlist mcp.vercel.com. See AGENTS.md > 'Vercel MCP'.

netlify.note: Official Netlify MCP server (@netlify/mcp, stdio). Requires a Netlify personal access token in NETLIFY_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (Netlify > User settings > Applications > Personal access tokens). For Cloud Agents the token must be added as a secret AND the network allowlist must include api.netlify.com (currently blocked: api.netlify.com returns no connection from cloud-agent egress). Used to provision a site / read its Site ID and validate the Netlify Blobs upload path.
